name: @pipeworx/mcp-pokemon

tools.name: get_pokemon
tools.description: Get stats, types, abilities, height, weight, and sprites for a Pokémon. Lookup by name (e.g., "pikachu") or ID (e.g., "25").

tools.name: get_type
tools.description: Check type effectiveness matchups and find Pokémon by type (e.g., "fire", "water"). Returns damage chart and up to 20 Pokémon.

tools.name: get_ability
tools.description: Look up a Pokémon ability (e.g., "static", "overgrow"). Returns effect description and all Pokémon that can have this ability.

tools.name: get_evolution_chain
tools.description: Trace a full evolution line by chain ID. Returns each stage with evolution triggers, level requirements, and items needed.

id.description: Evolution chain ID (e.g., 1 for Bulbasaur line, 10 for Caterpie line)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pokemon forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pokemon pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
